articles.detail: 5 cycles, 5 completed; 10/11/13/15/14 stories selected against targets of 11/12/13/15/15, with the 10:00 and 22:00 selectors each stopping one short on a thin feed; 1 quarantined

experiment: Skipped. No experiment is active and no pause gate is set. Latin America is the one chronic miss and it is a supply problem a source-list change could reach, but the candidate outlet's Event Registry URI cannot be verified from the tuning session (no API key here), and CURATED_SOURCES feeds a query that is not fail-soft, so no unverified entry was merged.
weakestArea: Latin America datelines are 2% against 5% (one of 53: the Centinela copper strike, Santiago), and have been under target on seven of the last nine days (3, 5, 2, 11, 0, 9, 3, 4, 2). The feed is the cause: across the 50 feed snapshots since 2026-09-28, about 2.7 of 76 stories per cycle were Latin American, none of them sourced to a Latin American outlet, and insightcrime.org, the only such entry in CURATED_SOURCES, supplied none. Multi-source fell to 26% from 37% because the 18:00 and 22:00 feeds carried three and four usable clusters; that is one day's reading after four days at 35-55%.
watching: Russia: a technician at the Irkutsk anti-plague institute died and dozens were quarantined while authorities name pneumonia; Trump is to raise it with Putin.
Hormuz: Brent is above $100, the US 30-year yield is back at its 2002 high, and Iraqi crude is being routed overland through Syria.
India: Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi were detained after the march on the Election Commission, and the Reserve Bank raised its repo rate to 5.5%, the first increase since 2023.
Black Sea: a tanker burned off Sochi after a reported Ukrainian drone strike and India protested formally; Russian attacks killed at least 24 across Ukraine, 14 in one Pryluky building.
Yemen: the Houthis report missile strikes on coalition forces near Bab el-Mandeb, sourced to state media alone with no coalition confirmation.
Chile: workers at the Centinela copper mine voted to strike after talks failed; no report gives duration, headcount or lost output.
Kenya: the Ebola follow-ups were pre-filtered twice as recaps of the 10-06 first-case story, so the US aid-cut angle has not run.
ASML's share move went unexplained by the feed for a fourth day.
coverageGaps: Latin America had one dateline; at 14:00 the only candidates were two thin Bloomberg items, which the selector skipped after Bloomberg's page-fetch failures on 10-06.
Tech was 0 against a floor of 3 at 10:00, when the feed had nothing from Ars Technica, 404 Media, The Register, The Decoder or Hacker News, and 2 against 3 at 22:00.
Politics had no multi-source pick at 18:00 or 22:00 and one at 10:00; economy had one at 10:00 and 18:00.
Science was 1 against 2 at 05:00, with nothing from Nature, Quanta, New Scientist, STAT, SciDev.Net or Carbon Brief in the feed.
Economy was 2 against 3 after dedup at 22:00, and politics 2 against 3 at 05:00.
Five stories rest on state media or advocacy outlets alone, up from two: the Houthi strikes, the Iran-US talks deadlock, Kosovo's new president, the UN resolution piece and NatCon in Israel.
Oceania had no dateline, and Europe fell from 21 to 7 as the Middle East rose from 6 to 18.
Thin picks were recovered for 8 of 14 sources, and for none of two at 22:00.
Six datelines are a country, not a place (United States three times, Pakistan, Yemen, United Arab Emirates); the editor left Pakistan because Dawn names no city.
Freshness was measured on 1 of 53 articles, after 0 of 54 yesterday, so the 0.4-day median is not a reading of the day.
context: All five cycles completed in an average of 896s (selector 189s, writer 220s, editor 105s; the 22:00 writer took 482s). Yesterday's quarantine problem cleared: the selector now tells the writer to give placeless science stories a dateline, and one article was quarantined against six. For the operator: a Latin American English-language outlet in CURATED_SOURCES (MercoPress is the obvious candidate) is the next experiment worth running, token-neutral because the curated query is one call whatever the list length, but its source URI should be checked against Event Registry first; adding Mexico and Argentina to GAP_COUNTRIES was tried on 2026-09-18 and produced no datelines. Odds rows were offered in four cycles (9 rows).
